ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels (black) with a global contrast ratio of approximately 10:1 based on localized high-intensity white scarring against the dark pigment.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black field across the entire visible surface. Scattered high-contrast white/grey focal points concentrated in circular rings and linear streaks across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 140 degrees and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (1-3 pixels) along the mid-lobe boundaries, transitioning to deeper, more jagged valleys (5-10 pixels) near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the lateral distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters. Significant groupings identified on the left lobe (lower mid-section) and right lobe (adjacent to the median notch).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear disruptions; one prominent vertical stroke on the left lobe and several horizontal/diagonal intersecting marks on the right lobe upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, creating a calcified, high-texture protrusion from the fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cluster of ring-shaped scars near the center-right of the fluke, varying in diameter and pixel intensity.
